title: Call to Repentance

questions.question: Come, let us return to the Lord; for he has torn us, that he may do what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:1 (ESV): "for he has torn us, that he may heal us; he has struck us down, and he will bind us up."

questions.question: After how many days will he revive us?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:2 (ESV): "After two days he will revive us;"

questions.question: On which day will he raise us up?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:2 (ESV): "on the third day he will raise us up,"

questions.question: For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:6 (ESV): "For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings."

questions.question: Your love is like what?
options: A morning cloud, like the dew that goes early away
questions.correctAnswer: A morning cloud, like the dew that goes early away
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:4 (ESV): "Your love is like a morning cloud, like the dew that goes early away."

questions.question: Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:5 (ESV): "I have slain them by the words of my mouth,"

questions.question: But like whom have they transgressed the covenant?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:7 (ESV): "But like Adam they transgressed the covenant;"

questions.question: Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:8 (ESV): "Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with blood."

questions.question: As robbers lie in wait for a man, so do a company of whom?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:9 (ESV): "As robbers lie in wait for a man, so the priests are banded together;"

questions.question: By the way to where do they murder?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:9 (ESV): "they murder on the way to Shechem,"

questions.question: Let us know; let us press on to know the Lord; his going out is as sure as the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:3 (ESV): "his going out is as sure as the dawn;"

questions.question: He will come to us as the showers, as the spring rains that water the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:3 (ESV): "as the spring rains that water the earth."

questions.question: What have I seen in the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:10 (ESV): "In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing;"

questions.question: For you also, O Judah, a what is appointed?
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:11 (ESV): "For you also, O Judah, a harvest is appointed."

questions.question: When will the harvest for Judah be appointed?
options: When I restore the fortunes of my people
questions.correctAnswer: When I restore the fortunes of my people
questions.explanation: Hosea 6:11 (ESV): "when I restore the fortunes of my people."

key_verse_text: For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
